title: AI CO-PILOT RECIPE: HOW TO USE POSTERMAKER

sections.title: ⚠️ THE REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI is blind unless guided. **Always verify:** The agent must read `DESIGN.md` before coding. **The Death Loop:** If the AI keeps breaking the design, stop. Force it to run `impeccable teach` and reload the context.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**The Global View:** A code-driven factory for generating high-craft, professional posters.
**The Motivation:** Stop tweaking pixels in Figma. Define content in JSON, let the agent apply the `Typst` visual engine.
**Why skip it?** If you just need a basic Google Doc.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
**Prerequisites:**
- `typst` CLI installed
- The `data/` and `assets/` folders populated
**Safe Credentials:** No API keys required. It runs 100% locally.
**Accelerants:** Impeccable Design Workflow scripts.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 1: BLUEPRINT
sections.content:
**Desc:** Start by editing `data/*.json` to define the poster content.
**The Prompt:** *'Draft a JSON payload for a poster based on template.md.'*
**Expected:** Clean JSON mapped to the 3-column grid.
**Failure:** The AI breaks JSON syntax.
**Fix:** Tell the agent to fix the trailing comma.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 2: BUILD
sections.content:
**Desc:** Apply visual tokens to `template.typ`.
**The Prompt:** *'Update DESIGN.md to use a warm slate palette with OKLCH values.'*
**Expected:** A cohesive, Living Neutral color scheme.
**Failure:** Contrast ratio is unreadable.
**Fix:** Adjust the OKLCH chroma/lightness values manually.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 3: AUDIT
sections.content:
**Desc:** Render and review visually.
**The Prompt:** *'Run typst compile main.typ to PNG and view the file.'*
**Expected:** A beautiful, correctly styled image.
**Manual Check:** Does the text contrast properly against the nodes?
**Guardrails:** Do not commit `template.typ` if it's illegible.

sections.title: 🚀 PHASE 4: SHIP
sections.content:
**Desc:** Export to PDF for printing or sharing.
**The Prompt:** *'Compile the final main.pdf and ensure vector fonts are embedded.'*
**Expected:** A high-resolution, print-ready PDF.

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS & TESTS
sections.content: **Validation:** Never let the AI edit `SPEC.md` or `SKILLS.md` directly without a manual diff review. The 'Factory' layer must remain protected from the 'Product' layer changes.

sections.title: 🚨 INCIDENT REPORT
sections.content:
**What Happened:** Text inside flowchart nodes became invisible.
**The Root Cause:** Inherited default cream text on light gray boxes.
**The Fix:** Updated `step-node` to explicitly use the `canvas` background and cream text.
**Prevention:** Always compile to PNG and inspect visually.

sections.title: 🔭 NEXT STEPS
sections.content:
**Future Learning:** Learn `typst` advanced grid techniques to span rows.
**Links:** Official docs at `typst.app/docs`.
